findings.title: The publish release-gate logic is untested and never returns NO-GO
evidence: tools/publish_audit.py:198 gate = GO if no P0/P1 else 'GO WITH CONDITIONS' (a P0 cannot produce NO-GO)
tests/test_publish_audit.py:16-93 covers only the secret scan and pack install, not the gate
tools/full_domain.py:432-442 correctly maps P0 -> NO-GO, so the two paths disagree
findings.impact: A focused published run with a P0 blocker reports a less severe verdict than the full-domain path, misleading the release decision.
findings.recommendation: Make publish_audit reuse the shared gate function and add a P0 test asserting NO-GO.

findings.title: run_toolchain writes CSV to a fixed shared temp path
evidence: Observed: lab self_test.sh -> findings_to_csv.py PermissionError on /tmp/toolchain_findings.csv (RESULT: FAIL)
findings.impact: Concurrent runs collide and a pre-created file makes the toolchain fail; the predictable path is also a symlink risk.

findings.title: The documented exec-bit invariant is not tested
evidence: no test asserts the mode of tracked shell scripts
findings.impact: The invariant can regress silently on Windows-authored commits.
findings.recommendation: Add a lint/test check over `git ls-files -s '*.sh'`.

report: Ran `tools/self_test.sh` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` on the lab workspace. Unit tests pass; the self-test toolchain step failed in the lab on a fixed temp path (environmental collision).
